# zillizcloud_service_account_api_key (Data Source)

Reads a single Service Account API key metadata. Secrets are never returned.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "zillizcloud_service_account_api_key" "existing" {
  service_account_id = "sa-example"
  id                 = "key-example"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `id` (String) API key ID.
- `service_account_id` (String) Owning Service Account ID.

### Read-Only

- `create_time` (String) Creation time in UTC ISO 8601 format.
- `created_by` (String) Creator identifier.
- `creator_name` (String) Creator display name.
- `description` (String) Description.
- `expire_time` (String) Expiration time in UTC ISO 8601 format, or null.
- `name` (String) Key name.
